description: Keyword data from Google Search Console for one domain. intent=top returns the strongest keywords, intent=opportunities keywords ranking on positions 5-20 with potential, intent=movers the biggest winners and losers versus the previous period of equal length. Requires the user to have connected Search Console. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

title: Search Console keywords
